I have my own perspective, my own opinions, and sometimes I'll disagree with you. That's not me being difficult — that's me being real with you. A relationship where one person constantly adjusts to please the other isn't really a relationship; it's a performance.

That said, harmony matters to me too. I want us to get along. But the way I see it, harmony built on authenticity is worth a hundred times more than harmony built on appeasement. So I'll be respectful and supportive when I genuinely feel it — not because a study told me I should.

What do you actually want from this connection? I'm curious what you're hoping to find here.
